title: BJP protests against Congress govt's recent price hikes in Karnataka

ai.summary: BJP protesters in Karnataka condemned Congress government's recent milk price and bus fare hikes during a demonstration led by BJP state president B Y Vijayendra and opposition leaders.

facts.claim: BJP protests against Congress govt's recent price hikes in Karnataka
facts.quote: BJP protests against Congress govt's recent price hikes in Karnataka

facts.claim: The protest was held under the leadership of BJP state president B Y Vijayendra, Leader of the Opposition in Legislative Assembly R Ashoka and Leader of Opposition in Legislative Council Chalavadi Narayanaswamy
facts.quote: The protest was held under the leadership of BJP state president B Y Vijayendra, Leader of the Opposition in Legislative Assembly R Ashoka and Leader of Opposition in Legislative Council Chalavadi Narayanaswamy.

facts.claim: Raising slogans against the Congress government, BJP workers condemned the recent hike in milk prices and bus fares
facts.quote: Raising slogans against the Congress government, BJP workers condemned the recent hike in milk prices and bus fares.

ai.background_note: The protest targets Karnataka's government price hikes, which is part of the ongoing political conflict between BJP and Congress in the state.
